stages.name: Foundation
stages.goal: The spine: data model, safe persistence, offline install, checks.
stages.exit: The app installs, works offline, and npm run ci:check passes in CI.

tasks.title: Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind 4 scaffold
Data model and Zustand store with all actions
Versioned persistence, migrations and backup/restore, with tests
Local-day date helpers (never UTC)
PWA: manifest, icons, offline service worker
CI (dashboard check, typecheck, tests, build) and GitHub Pages deploy
Memory system, dashboard and builder subagent (adapted from an earlier project)

stages.name: Daily-use MVP
stages.goal: Everything needed to run a day, a week and a set of goals.
stages.exit: Owner can run his whole day from Itqan.

tasks.title: Today: progress ring, intention + mood, tasks by time of day, overdue, habits, goals, daily wisdom, Hijri date
Plan: week view with Inbox, drag between days, per-day quick add
Habits: schedules, targets, streaks, 7-day backfill, heatmaps
Goals: numeric and milestone goals, check-ins, pace and per-day need
Focus timer: presets, links to task/goal/area, survives reload, notifications
Insights: level, XP per day, area balance, habit consistency, activity heatmap, achievements
Weekly review: auto summary and reflection prompts
Settings: profile, theme, week start, areas, backup/restore, delete all
Command bar (Ctrl+K) with natural-language quick add and keyboard shortcuts
XP, levels, achievements and celebrations (derived, ADR-005)
Onboarding with the owner's routine as a starter set

stages.name: Shaped by real use
stages.goal: Fix and add what a week of daily use shows is missing.
stages.exit: the owner's feedback from the first two weeks is addressed.

tasks.title: Local single-file app + app-menu launcher, no server needed (ADR-012)
Memories: timeline, tags, favourites, search, On this day
Ideas: capture, board by stage, turn into task or goal
Reminders: repeating important dates with alerts (recurrence engine, tested)
Desktop notifications via local helper service, secured and tested (ADR-013)
Publish to GitHub and enable Pages
Recurring tasks
Reorder tasks by drag within a day
Excuse a habit day (travel, illness) without breaking the streak
Reminders at chosen times
Code-split pages to reduce first load
Arabic interface with RTL (if Q2 says yes)
Photos in memories (IndexedDB storage + backup) — if Q7 says yes

stages.name: Learning companions
stages.goal: Purpose-built trackers for what Owner studies.
stages.exit: Quran, books, courses and French each have a dedicated view that feeds goals.

tasks.title: Quran revision map with spaced-revision suggestions (Q4)
Reading list: books, pages, shelves
Course tracker: modules and lessons
French: vocabulary review and oral-practice log

stages.name: Sync between devices
stages.goal: The same data on laptop and iPhone, free, encrypted (ADR-016).
stages.exit: Laptop and iPhone stay in sync without data loss.

tasks.title: Sync design: entities, stamps, tombstones, encryption (ADR-016)
Sync engine + GitHub client, tested against a fake GitHub incl. save conflicts
Sync setup UI, status badge, 'I already use Itqan' onboarding path
iPhone reminders via Calendar export (.ics, ADR-017)
Owner: create repos + token; publish the app; connect laptop and iPhone

open_questions.title: Should the week start on Saturday?
More than one device, or sharing soon?
Quran revision unit: juz, hizb, pages or surahs? Memorisation too?
Plan the day around prayer times?

log.entry: S4-01…S4-04: encrypted GitHub sync (ADR-016) — per-entity merge with stamps and tombstones, AES-GCM/PBKDF2, sha-checked writes with retry; 22 new tests incl. an engine test against a fake GitHub that forces a real save conflict. iPhone reminders via .ics Calendar export (ADR-017). Waiting on the owner's GitHub setup to go live.

S2-08…S2-11: Memories, Ideas and Reminders. Schema v2 (migration tested, and verified on real v1 data in the browser). Desktop notifications through the itqan-reminders user service (ADR-013): token + origin + host guards each tested by attack; end-to-end test from the file:// app delivered a notification.

S2-00: Itqan now runs as a local app with no server — a single offline HTML file opened by an 'Itqan' launcher in Chrome app mode with its own profile (ADR-012). Verified that data persists across a Chrome restart.
Stages 0 and 1 built in one session: the full daily-use MVP, 32 tests, CI and Pages deploy, and the proven memory system. Verified in the browser on desktop and phone widths, light and dark.
